channel_conventions.decks: deck 1/2/3/4 controls: status 0x94/0x95/0x96/0x97 (and 0xB4..0xB7, 0xE4..0xE7) = MIDI ch 5..8; deck 3/4 = layer deck_cd
channel_conventions.fx: effect unit 1/2: status 0x98/0x99 and 0xB8/0xB9 = MIDI ch 9/10
channel_conventions.shift: +SHIFT rows are separate codes on the same channel
channel_conventions.pads_mode: HOT CUE mode; other pad modes in footnotes.md
